revision_summary: Two fixes needed on rerun: (1) Correct the timestamp misattribution in rep_intent.evidence[1] — the 'what got you interested in looking at solar?' line is spoken by rep at 00:30 as part of a continuous turn, not at 00:38 (00:38 is the customer's reply beginning 'No. I've been interested'). (2) The central 'underused interest anchor' narrative (cherry_pick_moments[0], interest_reason_audit, coaching_focus priority 2) rests on a garbled, speaker-ambiguous transcript segment at 00:41-00:44 where 'I thought I would maybe take this route since I was since I was a little kid' is attributed to the customer but appears embedded in a rep-labeled line that also contains rep dialogue ('Okay. Awesome. Is this kind of your first time in the house?'). Stage 3 should either flag this transcription ambiguity explicitly and reduce confidence in the coaching claim, or drop/downgrade the 'underused interest anchor' as a top-2 coaching priority given the shaky evidentiary basis. Additionally, fix the schema_reference in cherry_pick_moments[3] from protocols.time_constraint (wrong — that's about call-duration questions) to analysis_directives.soft_outcome_distinction, which actually covers locked-time-vs-vague-callback distinctions. Also flag the anomalous ~57-second silent gap at 01:37-02:34 and the odd 'You're in qualified?' line at 03:03 as transcript-quality/speaker-attribution concerns that lower confidence in the back-half DQ narrative.
